title: The Carathéodory metric on Teichmüller space of genus two surface
summary: Let $\Tei_{g,n}$ be the Teichmüller space of Riemann surfaces of genus $g$ with $n$ marked points. It is conjectured that the Teichmüller and Carathéodory metrics coincide on a Teichmüller disk exactly when every zero of the associated holomorphic quadratic differential (away from marked points) has even order. Gekhtman and Markovic verified this conjecture for $\Tei_{0,5}\cong \Tei_{1,2}$. We confirm the conjecture for $\Tei_{0,6}\cong\Tei_{2,0}$.
